title: Find out why the legibility check once read the dark lower-third caption preview as unreadable
goal: Main's tests went red once on 2026-11-12 because the legibility check read the dark Lower third caption preview as grey text on the same grey. The next run on the same app code passed, so either the check sometimes photographs the preview before its words are drawn, or the preview really does sometimes draw unreadable words. Find out which and fix that one.
notes: CI run https://github.com/dzearing/photonz/actions/runs/43367299841 (commit 610f1dc95), Test slice 1 of 3, step Run tests, after all 5535 tests passed: 'legibility: 1546 words and icons measured on 122 specimens, light and dark, in 43s' then 'legibility: UNREADABLE (the user: no white on white or black on black, ever): Caption preview, Lower third, still, dark: 1.00:1, #232323 on #232323, at 10,10 (caption-preview-lower-third-still-dark.png)' and exit 1. The next CI run, 43368952566 on b20245458 (a queue-only commit, same app code), passed. Not reproduced locally; the check lives in Scripts/test.sh (grep photonz-legibility). Filed by a-long-reference-edit-opens-in-the-probe-in-one, which does not touch captions. Epic is video-perf only because the queue requires a now-staged epic; it is a test-health item.
acceptance: The cause is named with evidence: a reproduction of the unreadable preview, or the check's timing shown to be the cause.
Whichever it is is fixed, and the legibility check passes 10 runs in a row on the caption previews.
